text:
Ana Gomez: Heads up — MeridianRetail renewal in ~28 days. Noticing a ~62% drop in active API calls last 14d vs prior 14d. Dashboard: https://app.redwood.com/customers/meridianretail/usage Can someone take a quick look? @Derek Huang can you own outreach? :eyes:

Derek Huang: On it. They brought in a new Head of Data (Lina Park) two weeks ago — our champion Tom moved to analytics. Possible deprioritization. Any recent notes from Tom or PO?

Jules Patel: Quick numbers I pulled:
```
-- usage by day (last 30)
2026-03-18: 85
2026-03-17: 88
...
2026-03-05: 900
2026-02-28: 610
```
Last 14d avg ~220 calls/day, prior 14d avg ~580. Also seeing a spike of 401s around Mar 5 from a single client version.

Priya Shah: Sounds like an enablement gap and a recent client-side regression. I can offer a 30-min tech workshop for Lina + analytics to walk the integration and cost tradeoffs. @Ben Lowe if they ask for pricing concessions how do we want to position a pilot?

Ben Lowe: If they're leaning to AtlasAI, we can propose a 3-month pilot discount + migration support. I'll flag RevOps but need a one-pager with expected volume. Also need usage split by endpoint and by seat.

renewal-bot: MeridianRetail renewal date 2026-04-18 — renewal owner: Ana Gomez. Reminder sent.

Ana Gomez: Ok — proposed async triage follow-up:
- Derek: add recent meeting notes with Lina (EOD today)
- Jules: run a health-check and root-cause the 401s, share brief remediation steps
- Priya: propose 2 workshop slots + draft agenda
- Ben: kick off RevOps concession request + one-pager
I'll tentatively schedule a 30-min QBR Tue 10am PT and invite Lina; can adjust.

Derek Huang: Notes added: Tom stepped back from platform ownership; Lina's first ask was "consolidated cost and latency report" and she said: "cost is our immediate priority". She also mentioned evaluating a cheaper quantized model from a vendor (AtlasAI).

Jules Patel: Health-check summary:
- KV cache miss rate up ~4x due to deployed client tag mismatch (client v2.2.0 calling v2.3.1 endpoints)
- Fix: force client SDK update to v2.3.1; patch reduces redundant calls by ~45% in our sim
Log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-05T14:22:07Z] auth: token invalid for client v2.2.0 -> 401
[2026-03-05T14:22:07Z] retry -> increased requests to auth endpoint
```
I'll prepare a 1-pager with the fix + rollback steps.

Priya Shah: Workshop slots I can do: Thu 2026-03-25 2pm PT or Fri 2026-03-26 11am PT. Draft agenda: 1) quick integration health, 2) cost vs quality (quantization tradeoffs), 3) migration checklist. I'll attach slides after review.

Ana Gomez: Great. I'll ping Lina with the QBR invite and workshop options. If they agree to a pilot, Ben please loop RevOps and legal early. @all — any blockers or thumbs? :thumbsup:

Ben Lowe: RevOps tentatively approved the concession model; legal wants a short SOW. I'll draft and share by EOD tomorrow.

Jules Patel: No blockers from infra side — will share the detailed health-check doc in this thread when ready.

Ana Gomez: Thanks team. Lets keep updates in this thread so we can reference before the QBR.

-- thread end --
